description: Insider trading in a company listed on B3, for one B3 listing written BVMF:TICKER (e.g. BVMF:WEGE3), from the monthly reports the company files for its insider bodies from 2018: the controlling shareholders, board of directors, executive officers, fiscal council and other statutory bodies, each with their related persons. Each body files as one, so no person is named. Returns the monthly totals per body in shares and units (bought, sold, the net value in reais and the holding at the month's end; a month with no purchase or sale by a body is left out), then every transaction in any of the company's own securities, newest first: options, debentures and stock loans included, each with its date, body, kind, security, signed quantity, price and value in reais. For a US listing's SEC Form 4 filings use GetInsiderTransactions.

maxMonths.description: Maximum monthly rows, newest month first (default 12, max 100).

monthOffset.description: Monthly rows to skip for paging back through older months (default 0).

ticker.description: B3 listing symbol BVMF:TICKER, e.g. BVMF:WEGE3. A bare ticker names a US listing and is answered with the company's B3 listings to ask with.
